apps.release_notes:
# Forge CDP Manager 0.3.2

## Catalog and documentation

- **Release notes in package** — `RELEASE-NOTES.md` ships inside each FAEP zip and surfaces in Fleet admin **About** fly-out.
- **Latest-only catalog** — publishing replaces older catalog rows for the same app id (one install target per package).
- **Handbook** — full changelog and operator guide on [fleet.forgesdlc.com](https://fleet.forgesdlc.com/docs-apps-forge-cdp-manager-page.html).

## Surface operations wall (from 0.3.1)

- Live surface grid: working sessions stream at ~1 fps; idle tabs refresh via CDP snapshots about once per minute.
- Fleet snapshot proxy at `/admin/apps/forge-cdp-manager/surfaces/{id}/snapshot.jpg`.
- Collapsed detail sections for sessions, workers, leases, and operator Edge.

## Operator notes

- Teams live preview requires `FORGE_CDP_STREAM_TEAMS=1` on the daemon host.
